request.prompt: Create exactly ONE faithful full-body 2D game-asset sprite of the standard kett Chosen from Mass Effect Andromeda, using the supplied BioWare four-view finished textured model sheet as the visual authority. The sheet shows ONE character from four angles: output ONLY the THIRD figure from the left, the complete three-quarter stance facing slightly toward image right. Match that view and posture precisely, with both empty hands lowered and both feet visible. Reproduce the irregular pale weathered bone crown and facial plates, narrow pale eyes, exposed pale bony shoulders and forearms, large olive green segmented raised collar and harness, charcoal ribbed abdominal and thigh panels, olive green gloves and tall segmented lower-leg armor, split-toed boots and small cyan technical lights. Preserve the exact creature anatomy, lean proportions, silhouette, bone shape, surface cracks, green armor seams, fasteners and visible asymmetry. Do not borrow a different angle or costume, add a weapon, change the head, or redesign the armor. Detailed realistic neutral-lit game-asset cutout, crisp edges and readable material distinctions. Exactly one subject and one view, no turnaround sheet. The full head, both hands and both soles must be inside the image. Make the figure at most 82 percent of canvas height, leaving clear generous transparent padding above the crown, below the feet and beside the hands. Fully transparent background; no black backdrop, floor, reflection, cast shadow, halo, scenery, text, labels, logos, border or other character.

notes: Four finished textured full-body views inspected by root; third panel selected for three-quarter pose.
Front, side and back help equipment identification; no weapon or unsupported equipment added.
